audit.why: full phases[].side and content win[] already agree row-for-row with the packet chart (Shen, Shen, Shen, Shen, Skill, Skill, Shen), and that shape matches the 53.47% win rate plus Locke's level-6 execute spike.
audit.corrected: No chart change. Level 6 and first item stay Skill; ratings left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere; spikes and do's talk about 'the post-E window' and 'the ten seconds' without ever tying a number to an ability.
audit.why: Locke's E is a FLAT 10s at every rank, his W is 18/17/16/15/14, Q is 10/9/8/7/6 and R is 120/100/80. The flat E is the single most trackable timer in the lane.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and dosFull[2] now state the flat 10s E and the commit window it opens.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (a) 'Silver Stake procs' is not in Locke's kit — his on-hit magic damage is his passive, and Spirit's Refuge blocks ATTACKS only, so his Q passes straight through it. (b) His R's grounding is never mentioned anywhere on the page, though it shuts off Shadow Dash and denies Stand United. (c) The E combo opens with an auto-attack reset and the page gives no wind-up tell.
audit.why: Riot text: Spirit's Refuge — 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' Locke's R carries grounding, execute and zone flags; his E carries autoReset.
audit.corrected: whys[2] and spikes[1] restate the block as attack-only and attach it to the E reset; whys[4], wants.foe[1] and dontsFull[1].d now carry the grounding; dosFull[1] carries the auto-reset tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] says 'Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.'
audit.why: Grievous Wounds reduces all healing, including the end-of-duration refund on his W. missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for exactly this ability.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now tells the reader to buy Grievous Wounds before long trades.

edits.before: Level 3 Spirit's Refuge negates his Silver Stake procs in every all-in.
edits.after: Level 3 Spirit's Refuge blocks his on-hit autos, though his Q passes through.

edits.before: At 6 your R execute answer is map pressure against his execute — the fight is even.
edits.after: At 6 his R grounds you — no Shadow Dash out, no R in; leave the zone early.

edits.before: Spirit's Refuge negates his Silver Stake procs in every all-in — his damage plan breaks.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks on-hit autos his E reset feeds — his 10s blink-bite loses its payload.

edits.before: W timed exactly on his Stake procs
edits.after: W timed exactly on his E-reset auto

edits.before: You caught below the execute line
edits.after: You grounded below the execute line

edits.before: Sit on your engage until his nails whiff
edits.after: Step back on his auto-attack reset wind-up

edits.before: His Q recasts whiffed and E is spent — take the trade your kit is built for.
edits.after: His combo opens on an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is your step-back cue.

edits.before: Locke wastes Ritual Nails — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: His E is a flat 10s — those ten seconds after are your window.

edits.before: E is his engage AND escape — a spent blink is the lane’s biggest cooldown; don’t waste yours before it.
edits.after: Purgatory grounds and executes — at low HP you cannot dash out of the zone once the artifact lands.

edits.before: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip (his damage is AP). A stopwatch/Zhonya’s-class answer beats Purgatory outright: untargetable at the floor = execute denied. Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.
edits.after: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip (his damage is AP). A stopwatch/Zhonya’s-class answer beats Purgatory outright: untargetable at the floor = execute denied. Grievous Wounds cuts his W refund — buy it before long trades.

notes: Locke's kit file carries NO ability names — only slots — so I could not verify 'Ritual Nails', 'Silver Stake' or 'Ashen Pursuit'. missingInteractions independently names W = Soul Ignition and E = Ashen Pursuit, so those two are probably right; 'Silver Stake' matches nothing in the kit or the interaction file and was removed where it appeared in editable-length fields (it still appears in the long `early` block). 'Ritual Nails' is used as the focus token champion-wide and I left it alone rather than guess. Also unverified: the page repeatedly calls Locke 'a 125-range' champion (phases[0].why, breakdown.early, breakdown.wave, report[4]) — the kit gives Q 950, E 425, R 1000 and no auto-attack range, so I could not confirm or correct 125 and left it untouched.
